data.message: I reported Frank’s body in medbay. My route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay. I didn’t see anyone on the way, but when I got into medbay, Frank’s body was there and Diana was also in medbay right near it. I reported immediately. Diana needs to explain what she was doing there.

I was navigation → security this round. I’ve been in security with Alice at the end, saw her there ticks 6 and 7. I didn’t go near medbay and didn’t see Frank, Bob, or Diana.

So from my side, Alice is at least away from medbay late round unless timing is weird. Bob’s report puts Diana directly in medbay with Frank’s body, so Diana definitely needs to explain her route and whether she just found it too or had been there earlier.

I started in weapons and then went to security. I saw Eve enter weapons from the security side around tick 4. After that I went to security, and Charlie came in from navigation around tick 6 and was still there with me at tick 7 when the meeting got called.

I didn’t go anywhere near medbay and didn’t see Frank at all. I can vouch that Charlie was in security late, so unless the kill happened much earlier, Charlie seems away from the body. Bob finding Frank in medbay with Diana right there is the main thing right now — I want to hear Diana’s route and why she was standing near the body.

I was in medbay because I had scan there. My route was electrical → medbay → electrical → medbay. I saw Frank alive in medbay earlier, and then I went back to electrical for a bit before returning.

When Bob came in, I had just gotten back into medbay and the report happened basically immediately. I didn’t kill Frank, and Bob didn’t see me kill — he only saw me in the room with the body. From my POV, Bob is the only one actually placing himself entering medbay right at report, and he has no one vouching his route either.

I get why it looks bad on me, but I’m saying I was there for task route and Frank was alive when I saw him earlier. We should also hear Eve because Alice/Charlie seem paired in security, and Bob/Eve are the ones with the least confirmed movement besides me.

I was security → weapons this round. I went into weapons from the security side and was doing asteroids when the meeting got called. I didn’t see anyone in my local view and I never went near medbay, so I can’t give direct info on the body.

Alice saying she saw me enter weapons around tick 4 lines up with my route, so that makes her story feel more credible to me. Alice and Charlie also seem to have each other in security late.

That leaves the medbay situation. Bob says he found Frank dead in medbay with Diana right there. Diana’s explanation is possible, but she’s admitting she was in and out of medbay and saw Frank alive earlier, which gives her the most opportunity. Bob could technically be self-reporting, but with only one duck and Diana being directly on the body, I think Diana is the stronger vote here unless someone has something else.

I’ll restate clearly: I came oxygen → upper engine → medbay. I saw nobody on the way. When I entered medbay, Frank was already dead and Diana was standing right there near the body, so I reported immediately.

After hearing everyone, Alice and Charlie seem paired in security late, and Alice also saw Eve go into weapons, so their routes line up away from medbay. Diana is the only person besides me confirmed at the body, and she admits she was in and out of medbay and saw Frank alive earlier. That gives her the strongest opportunity.

I don’t see a better suspect here — I think this is Diana.

My info hasn’t changed: I was navigation → security, and Alice was with me in security at ticks 6 and 7. Alice and I can vouch for each other being away from medbay late.

Eve’s route also lines up with Alice seeing her go into weapons, so I’m less suspicious there.

That leaves Bob and Diana at medbay. Bob could theoretically self-report, but Diana was standing by the body and admits she was in and out of medbay and saw Frank alive earlier. That’s the strongest opportunity we have.

I’m voting Diana unless there’s some last-second contradiction.

My info is the same: I went weapons → security. I saw Eve enter weapons from the security side around tick 4, then I was in security when Charlie came in from navigation around tick 6, and Charlie stayed there with me until the report.

So Charlie is definitely away from medbay late, and Eve’s route also matches what I saw. That really narrows it to the medbay situation.

Between Bob and Diana, Bob could technically self-report, but Diana being right there by Frank’s body and admitting she was in and out of medbay with Frank alive earlier is the strongest opportunity. I don’t have direct vision of the kill, but based on everyone’s routes, Diana is the vote I’m most comfortable with.

I get that it looks bad because Bob reported while I was in medbay, but please think about the timing and behavior here.

I saw Frank alive in medbay around tick 5, then I stepped back toward electrical and came back to finish scan. When Bob came in and reported, I had just gotten back there. If I had killed Frank, why would I just stand in medbay next to the body waiting for someone to walk in from upper engine? That makes no sense — I would have left or self-reported immediately.

Bob is the only person with an unvouched route directly into medbay, and he controls the report story. Alice/Charlie are paired, Eve is at least seen away earlier, so yes, it’s between Bob and me — but Bob’s “I walked in and Diana was there” is not proof I killed. It’s just proof he reported while I was nearby.

I think Bob killed Frank and reported because he found me coming back into medbay and needed to pin it fast. I’m voting Bob.

My info is still just security → weapons. I was in weapons doing asteroids when the report happened, and I didn’t see the body or anyone near medbay.

From all the stories, Alice and Charlie are pretty well paired in security late, and Alice’s sighting of me entering weapons matches my route, so I don’t think the kill is likely there.

So it’s really Bob vs Diana. Bob could be self-reporting, but Diana was actually in medbay with the body, says she saw Frank alive earlier, left, and came back. That’s a lot of opportunity around the exact room where Frank died. Diana’s point about “why would I stand there” is fair, but Ducks do get caught near bodies sometimes, and Bob’s report has been consistent.

I don’t have direct proof, but based on the info we have, Diana is still the stronger vote for me.
